_meta.name: spe1_isothermal
_meta.description: Isothermal SPE1 black-oil physics with 5001-point OBL grid (1-450 bar). BlackOil builds its own evaluator stack (densities, viscosities, rel-perms, capillary pressures, rock compaction) from the PVT data file at construction time, so this preset deliberately ships NO property_regions block — the caller only needs to override pvt_path with the model-local PVT data file. components/phases are shipped so callers don't need to repeat them at PhysicsSpec level.
references: Odeh (1981) — SPE 9723, SPE Comparative Solution Project (SPE1)
